This vulnerability breaks the hardening expectations for SELinux administration workflows and can lead to the unauthorized modification of security labels on sensitive system objects.

These padding bits do not correspond to any validator and are ignored by the actual BLS aggregate-signature check, so a malicious or compromised block producer can set them to reach the required quorum while gathering fewer genuine validator signatures than the protocol demands. As a result, nodes that import or intercept the header accept it as correctly signed without a real two-thirds quorum, weakening consensus safety and undermining finality. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.20.

vuln_description: isomorphic-git is a pure JavaScript implementation of Git for Node.js and browsers. Prior to 1.38.6, isomorphic-git reads a server-controlled targetSize while applying a packfile delta in src/utils/applyDelta.js and passes it without a bound to Buffer.alloc(targetSize). A malicious or man-in-the-middle-controlled remote can send one delta header that causes git.clone() or git.fetch() to allocate approximately 2 GB before validating the actual delta output. GitPackIndex.fromPack swallows the later size-mismatch error, so a host with sufficient memory may retain the resource waste without a visible failure, while containers, serverless functions, and small virtual machines may terminate. Node.js heap limits do not mitigate the off-heap Buffer allocation. This issue is fixed in version 1.38.6.

nfsd: hold cl_lock in client_has_openowners()

client_has_openowners() walks clp->cl_openowners and reads so_stateids

BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in client_has_state+0x10a/0x140
  fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c:3718 client_has_openowners()
  nfsd4_exchange_id

  nfsd_dispatch

list.

name: CVE-2026-94567
description: NukeViet CMS SVG Upload XSS Filter Bypass — CVSS 9.3
vuln_description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. Prior to 4.5.12 and 4.6.02, an attacker with access to an SVG upload flow can hide a script element in an internal DTD entity. NukeViet\Files\Upload::check_svg_tmpfile() loads the document without entity expansion, leaving a DOMEntityReference, and sanitize_svg_dom() inspects only element nodes, while browsers expand the entity when the stored file is served as image/svg+xml. The SVG path also returned before verify_image() and preserved the original bytes, so the hidden script reached disk unchanged. Guest comment attachments make the upload unauthenticated only when a module's comment feature is open to the All or Guest group and allowattachcomm is enabled; module administrators can also use the file manager, allowing same-origin script execution in an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.12 and 4.6.02.

name: CVE-2026-94565
description: NukeViet CMS Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Admin Panel — CVSS 9.3
vuln_description: NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From the 3.x release line until 4.6.01, an unauthenticated visitor can submit a Contact module message containing an event-handler attribute prefixed by a slash. NukeViet\Core\Request::filterTags() tokenizes attributes using only ASCII spaces, so it sees /onerror and misses the ^on denylist, while the browser treats the slash as a separator and activates onerror. The message is stored and rendered without output encoding in the administration panel, which lacks a Content Security Policy, allowing same-origin JavaScript execution when an administrator opens the message. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.01.
